scripts.build: npm run build -w @cake-pos/ui && npm run build -w @cake-pos/server
scripts.ui:test: cd apps/ui && for t in cashier baker inventory inventory-edge owner devices empty badinput serverstop offline dayclose; do UI_DIST=/tmp/ui-dist-$t node build.mjs >/dev/null && UI_DIST=/tmp/ui-dist-$t node test/$t.mjs || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run test -w @cake-pos/panel && npm run test -w @cake-pos/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @cake-pos/panel && npm run typecheck -w @cake-pos/client && npm run typecheck -w @cake-pos/server && npm run typecheck -w @cake-pos/ui
